﻿// Copyright (c) Microsoft. All rights reserved.

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Google.Core;

/// <summary>
/// Represents the metadata associated with a Gemini response.
/// </summary>
public sealed class GeminiMetadata
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the number of prompt tokens used.
    /// </summary>
    [JsonPropertyName("prompt_token_count")]
    public int PromptTokenCount { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the number of candidate tokens used.
    /// </summary>
    [JsonPropertyName("candidates_token_count")]
    public int CandidatesTokenCount { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the total number of tokens used.
    /// </summary>
    [JsonPropertyName("total_token_count")]
    public int TotalTokenCount { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the block reason for the prompt feedback.
    /// </summary>
    [JsonPropertyName("block_reason")]
    public string? BlockReason { get; set; }
}

﻿// Copyright (c) Microsoft. All rights reserved.

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Google.Core;

/// <summary>
/// Represents the content of a chat message from the Gemini model.
/// </summary>
public sealed class GeminiChatMessageContent
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the role of the author.
    /// </summary>
    [JsonPropertyName("role")]
    public string Role { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the content of the message.
    /// </summary>
    [JsonPropertyName("content")]
    public string Content { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the model ID.
    /// </summary>
    [JsonPropertyName("model_id")]
    public string ModelId { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the metadata associated with the message.
    /// </summary>
    [JsonPropertyName("metadata")]
    public GeminiMetadata? Metadata { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets or sets the functions tool calls.
    /// </summary>
    [JsonPropertyName("functions_tool_calls")]
    public List<GeminiFunctionToolCall>? FunctionsToolCalls { get; set; }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Google.Core;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class GeminiChatCompletionClientTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_ShouldLogInformation_WhenMetadataIsValid()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<GeminiChatCompletionClient>>();
        var client = new Mock<GeminiChatCompletionClient>(
            new System.Net.Http.HttpClient(),
            "modelId",
            "apiKey",
            GoogleAIVersion.V1,
            mockLogger.Object) { CallBase = true };

        var metadata = new GeminiMetadata
        {
            PromptTokenCount = 10,
            CandidatesTokenCount = 20,
            TotalTokenCount = 30
        };

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new GeminiChatMessageContent
            {
                Metadata = metadata
            }
        };

        // Act
        client.Object.LogUsage(chatMessageContents);

        // Assert
        mockLogger.Verify(
            logger => logger.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Prompt tokens: 10. Completion tokens: 20. Total tokens: 30.")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.Is<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>((v, t) => true)),
            Times.Once);
    }
}
